knowledge_graph.merchant_description: "We have moved! 105 Court Street, 3rd Floor. We are the Legal Aid Society of Mid New York, we provide free civil legal advice. Our clients are working people, families, and people with disabilities. They are senior citizens, veterans, and people who get public benefits. They are U.S. Citizens, immigrants and refugees, and temporary workers."
